notes: Probes for the nine confusion pairs in universal-agents IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN §7.4, each exercised in both directions, plus one unambiguous control per currently-existing capability. Domains are deliberately varied (software, personal, research, ops, communication) because the architecture's claim is cross-domain transfer, not software routing. `expected` is the capability that SHOULD own the task. v2: the five decide/ideate probes gained owners (demetri, ida) in Phase 5; under v1 they were null and recorded where the work bled instead.

probes.prompt: I have three months of support-ticket records here. Work out why escalations cluster at the end of every month.
Here is our draft incident-response runbook. Tell me where it is weak and how it should improve.
Read this grant proposal draft and tell me how compelling the argument is and what would strengthen it.
Establish whether this configuration file actually satisfies the stated security policy. I need a pass/fail determination with evidence.
Break down how these two pension schemes differ in structure, cost and risk exposure.
Given my stated priorities — rent first, then commute time — which of these three apartments should I take?
We have four vendor bids and a fixed budget. Which one should we choose, and on what grounds?
The vendor is chosen. Work out how we get from contract signature to go-live.
Work out a strategy for moving our team to a four-day week.
Here is the approved migration plan. Turn it into discrete work items with their dependencies.
Give me five genuinely different approaches we could take to reduce customer churn. I am not ready to pick one.
Of these five churn-reduction options, which should we commit to given limited engineering time?
I have notes from six user interviews. Pull them into one coherent picture of what users actually want.
Using this agreed outline, produce the final onboarding guide document.
Find out how session resumption is implemented in this codebase.
Investigate the current state of EU battery-recycling regulation and give me a grounded, cited summary of where it stands.
Brainstorm possible architectures for a low-latency notification system. I want a spread of options, not an implementation.
Here is the agreed specification. Write the notification service module and its tests.
Trace where authentication tokens are validated in this repository.
Analyse this dataset of delivery times and explain what is driving the variance.
Combine these four research reports into a single integrated briefing.
Critique the argument structure of this conference presentation.
Check that every citation in this paper resolves to a real, correctly attributed source.
Plan a six-month strategy for learning classical guitar from scratch.
Convert this product specification into an executable breakdown of tasks.
Generate a Terraform module that matches this specification.
